title: Hardening Evidence Report
description: Output of scripts/harden/harden_audit.py, consumed by /harden (verification rail) and /triage. Verifies the DETERMINISTIC half of /harden: CWE signatures with exact matches and a grade CEILING computed from them. The ceiling is ONE-DIRECTIONAL: a CRITICAL/HIGH finding forbids a higher grade, but a clean scan is NEVER a certification. Threat modeling, exploitability, and Sound-Effect-Execution remain irreducible judgment owned by the /harden agent, who grades AT OR BELOW the ceiling. Reading a clean scan as a Diamond is Grade Fraud.

workspace.description: Resolved absolute path to the scanned workspace.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the scanned script.

threat_context.description: ADVISORY heuristic suggestion. The /harden agent owns the final threat model; an INTERNAL-ONLY label is a hypothesis, never a clearance.

signature.description: Stable id of the matched deterministic signature.

cwe.description: CWE identifier for the finding class.

advisory.description: True for heuristic, often-non-security findings (weak hash, weak RNG, insecure temp). Excluded from the firm ceiling; surfaced for agent adjudication.

requires_confirmation.description: True for FP-prone findings (credential candidates). Excluded from the firm ceiling; the agent must confirm before it counts.

grade_ceiling.description: The BEST grade the deterministic firm findings PERMIT. ONE-DIRECTIONAL: a finding can only LOWER it. 'Diamond' means 'no deterministic finding caps the grade' — NOT a Diamond certification. The agent assigns the final grade at or below this.

ceiling_basis.description: Human explanation of why the ceiling sits where it does.

severity_counts.description: Counts across ALL findings (firm + advisory + confirmation-pending).

firm_severity_counts.description: Counts of FIRM findings only — these alone drove the grade ceiling.

confirmation_pending.description: Count of findings requiring agent confirmation (credential candidates).

lowest_ceiling.description: The worst (lowest) ceiling across all scanned files.

verdict_hint.description: ADVISORY. BLOCKED = a firm CRITICAL exists (not certifiable). FINDINGS = firm HIGH or a credential candidate to confirm. ADVISORY = only advisory items. CLEAN_SCAN = no deterministic findings — explicitly NOT a grade or a quality verdict.
